RESOLUTION TO AUTHORIZE THE CREATION OF A RESERVE FUND ACCOUNT WITH COLONY BANK IN CONNECTION WITH FINANCING CONDITIONS OF
2:
WHEREAS, on August 20, 2009, at a called meeting of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners, said Board unanimously voted to adopt a resolution, authorizing the Treutlen County Commissioners to create and otherwise open a Reserve Fund account at Colony Bank, in connection with loan requirements issued by the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), Rural Development branch; and

WHEREAS, Treutlen County has applied for and obtained loan approval from the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), Rural Development branch, for long-term financing of a portion of the Treutlen County Jail Construction Project expenses (hereinafter “Project”); and

WHEREAS, USDA has required, as a condition of the loan, that Treutlen County create and maintain a Reserve Fund account, wherein it deposits additional sums, amounting to an additional ten (10%) percent of each projected loan payment, into said Reserve Fund account, for a designated period of time, in order to create a separate fund by which Treutlen County could make the

AUG-26-2889 15:89 From: Tom Everett 9125834052 To: 5296062 scheduled loan payments from, in the alternative, should its projected revenues for the payment of the indebtedness fall short of the loan obligations,

THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners hereby authorize and otherwise approve the creation of such “Reserve Fund” account with Colony Bank, to be maintained and operated pursuant to all relevant loan conditions imposed by the United States Department of Agriculture, Rural Development branch.

This the 20 day of August, 2009.
